parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of N SMC resources. SMC resources include migration sources and jobs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the SMC resource. Valid values:

*   sourceserver: migration source.
*   replicationjob: migration job.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc tag-resources --resource-type sourceserver --resource-id s-bw526m1vi6x20c6g0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 's-bw526m1vi6x20c6g0000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType sourceserver
